decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard quickly. The strategy involves controlling the game with disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize while setting up the combo. Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional control and protection for the combo pieces. The goal is to set up a quick and powerful reanimation combo that overwhelms the opponent before they can react effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade mechanics to dig into the deck and cast powerful spells for free, while also utilizing graveyard recursion to bring back powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to cycle through the deck with cards like Subtlety and Street Wraith to set up powerful Living End casts, while using cards like Endurance to disrupt the opponent's graveyard interactions. By combining cascade mechanics with graveyard recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main idea of the deck is to control the game by ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck utilizes cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Malevolent Rumble to slow down the opponent, while also using ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to quickly get out big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. The deck also includes removal spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to deal with threats and maintain board control, making it difficult for the opponent to execute their game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana and casting multiple spells in a single turn to create a storm effect. Cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual help reduce the cost of spells, while Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames allow for spell recursion. The goal is to chain together spells like Reckless Impulse and Desperate Ritual to build up a huge storm count, ultimately leading to a game-winning play with cards like March of Reckless Joy or Wish. This deck is all about explosive turns and overwhelming your opponent with a flurry of spells.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and other mana acceleration cards to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also includes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large, hard-to-deal-with creatures and control spells while also maintaining a high mana advantage. The deck aims to establish board presence and dominate the game with its powerful creatures and control capabilities.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creature cards with blink effects to gain value from entering and leaving the battlefield triggers. Utilizing cards like Solitude and Flickerwisp, along with Ephemerate and Teferi, Time Raveler, allows for constant removal and disruption while maintaining a steady stream of threats. The mix of control elements like Fatal Push and hand disruption with the strong creature base makes for a versatile and powerful aggressive strategy in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

The deck aims to win through a powerful combo using Goblin Charbelcher, while controlling the game with counterspells and disruption. It utilizes a variety of spells to control the board and disrupt opponents' strategies, while also generating mana with cards like Lotus Bloom. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and efficient, allowing the player to quickly assemble their combo and secure victory. The key strategy is to carefully manage resources and timing to outmaneuver opponents and overwhelm them with a lethal combination of spells.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The control aspect of the deck comes from cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Chalice of the Void, as well as disruption spells like Dismember and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to control the game early on, while ramping up to play unbeatable threats in the mid to late game.

The deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and strong removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm help control the board and push for victory. The deck also includes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos to search for key creatures and spells, providing consistency and staying power in games. By combining efficient threats with disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure quick wins.

This deck focuses on quickly getting creatures into the graveyard and reanimating them at instant speed, allowing for powerful combo plays. Using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude, the deck aims to bring back creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm opponents. Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces while cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending provide card advantage and filtering. The deck also includes various utility lands and spells to support the main reanimation strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Broodscale Bloodchief's ability to create an infinite loop with Sowing Mycospawn and Blade of the Bloodchief, allowing for a massive amount of creature tokens to be generated. This combo is supported by cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board, as well as Eldrazi Temple and Boseiju, Who Endures to accelerate and protect the combo. The deck also includes various utility cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Delighted Halfling to provide additional options and flexibility in different situations.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful board presence using artifacts and aggressive creatures. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells to control the game. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga, the deck generates mana advantage while deploying threats like Pinnacle Emissary and Engineered Explosives to apply pressure. By establishing a fast clock and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Metallic Rebuke and Tormod's Crypt, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and deal damage quickly using cheap spells and creatures. The deck aims to apply pressure early with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with Lightning Bolt and Slickshot Show-Off. The inclusion of Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge allows the deck to pump up its creatures and finish off the opponent swiftly. Overall, the deck focuses on being proactive and efficient in its strategy to win the game.

The essence of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. The deck also includes creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects to generate value and maintain board control. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while enabling consistent access to all necessary colors. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently answering threats, disrupting the opponent's strategy, and out-valuing them over the course of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It utilizes a wide range of cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan, including hand disruption, graveyard hate, and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by trading one-for-one and eventually pulling ahead with powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Solitude. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also including utility lands to provide additional advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent, while also utilizing blink effects to protect key creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggro with blink, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while also controlling the tempo of the game. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures like Quantum Riddler and Emperor of Bones, along with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to protect and strengthen them. With a combination of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.
